System Definition Schema

Type: object

Schema for HPC system definitions

root name
Type: string

System name.

Must be at least 1 characters long

root provider
Type: object

Hosting facility / provider information.

root provider name
Type: string

Provider / hosting facility name.

Must be at least 1 characters long

root provider location
Type: string

Physical location of the provider.

root provider persistent_identifier
Type: object

Persistent identifier for the provider (e.g. ROR ID).

root provider persistent_identifier identifier_name
Type: string

Type / name of the identifier (ROR, etc.)

root provider persistent_identifier id
Type: string

Value of identifier (the actual ID)

root provider website
Type: stringFormat: uri

Provider website URL.

root provider further_metadata
Type: object

Free-form key-value metadata.

Each additional property must conform to the following schema

root provider further_metadata additionalProperties
Type: string

root provider comment
Type: string

Free-text comment.

root location
Type: string

Physical location.

Must be at least 1 characters long

root installed_at
Type: stringFormat: date-time

Installation date (RFC3339: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ).

root parts
Type: array

System partitions or components.

Must contain a minimum of 1 items

No Additional Items

Each item of this array must be:

root parts SystemPart
Type: object

root parts parts items id
Type: string

Unique identifier for this part (UUID or semantic ID).

Must be at least 1 characters long

root parts parts items name
Type: string

Human-readable partition name.

Must be at least 1 characters long

root parts parts items provider
Type: string

Part provider.

root parts parts items product_name
Type: string

Product name (optional).

root parts parts items installed_at
Type: stringFormat: date-time

Date installation started (RFC3339).

root parts parts items accepted_at
Type: stringFormat: date-time

Date accepted (RFC3339, optional).

root parts parts items funders
Type: array of string

List of funding entities.

 No Additional Items

Each item of this array must be:

root parts parts items funders funders items
Type: string

Must be at least 1 characters long

root parts parts items part_type
Type: enum (of string)

Part type: compute, other, or storage.

Must be one of:

  • "compute"
  • "other"
  • "storage"

root parts parts items other_type_name
Type: string

Required if part_type is 'other'.

root parts parts items node_count
Type: integer

Number of nodes in this part.

Value must be greater or equal to 1

root parts parts items power_draw_peak
Type: object

Peak power draw.

root parts parts items power_draw_peak quantity
Type: number

Numeric value.

root parts parts items power_draw_peak unit
Type: string

Unit of measurement.

Must be at least 1 characters long

root parts parts items power_draw_peak comment
Type: string

Optional comment or notes about this value.

root parts parts items power_draw_average
Type: object

Average power draw.

root parts parts items power_draw_peak quantity
Type: number

Numeric value.

root parts parts items power_draw_peak unit
Type: string

Unit of measurement.

Must be at least 1 characters long

root parts parts items power_draw_peak comment
Type: string

Optional comment or notes about this value.

root parts parts items storage_system
Type: object

Shared/network storage system data (separate from on-node storage (for this, see below)). Add cumulative storage data here, if part is storage.

Type: string

Unique identifier for this storage type.

Must be at least 1 characters long

root parts parts items storage_system name
Type: string

Storage name.

Must be at least 1 characters long

Type: string

Storage type.

Must be at least 1 characters long

root parts parts items storage_system manufacturer
Type: string

Manufacturer.

root parts parts items storage_system product_name
Type: string

Product name.

Type: object

Type: number

Type: string

Unit of measurement.

Must be at least 1 characters long

Type: string

Optional comment or notes about this value.

Type: object

Type: object

root parts parts items comment
Type: string

Optional comment or notes about this system part.

root parts parts items inherits_from
Type: string

Name of the parent part to inherit from. All fields are inherited unless explicitly overridden in this part definition.

root parts parts items node_types
Type: array

Node type designs for this part (1..N node types). Each entry represents a distinct node configuration.

Must contain a minimum of 1 items

No Additional Items

Each item of this array must be:

root parts parts items node_types NodeDesign
Type: object

Node type design specification. A part can have multiple node types (1..N).

root parts parts items node_types node_types items id
Type: string

Unique identifier for this node type.

Must be at least 1 characters long

root parts parts items node_types node_types items node_type_name
Type: string

Human-readable name for this node type within the part.

Must be at least 1 characters long

root parts parts items node_types node_types items node_count
Type: integer

Number of nodes of this type.

Value must be greater or equal to 1

root parts parts items node_types node_types items cpu
Type: array

CPU specifications for this node type (1..N CPU types).

Must contain a minimum of 1 items

No Additional Items

Each item of this array must be:

root parts parts items node_types node_types items cpu CPU
Type: object

root parts parts items node_types node_types items cpu cpu items id
Type: string

Unique identifier for this CPU type.

Must be at least 1 characters long

root parts parts items node_types node_types items cpu cpu items manufacturer
Type: string

CPU manufacturer (free text, 'AMD', 'Intel', 'Ampere Computing').

root parts parts items node_types node_types items cpu cpu items name
Type: string

CPU model name.

Must be at least 1 characters long

root parts parts items node_types node_types items cpu cpu items sku
Type: string

CPU SKU or part number.

root parts parts items node_types node_types items cpu cpu items architecture
Type: string

CPU microarchitecture.

root parts parts items node_types node_types items cpu cpu items isa
Type: string

Instruction Set Architecture.

root parts parts items node_types node_types items cpu cpu items cores_per_node
Type: integer

Number of CPU cores per node.

Value must be greater or equal to 1

root parts parts items node_types node_types items cpu cpu items threads_per_core
Type: integer Default: 1

Hardware threads per core.

Value must be greater or equal to 1

root parts parts items node_types node_types items cpu cpu items tdp
Type: object

Thermal Design Power (TDP) with unit.
